bagPolicy.summary: All bags and personal items are subject to inspection at the entrance. Security screening is mandatory for all attendees.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is on a first-come, first-served basis with no tailgating allowed. Bicycle parking is available outside the South Gate. Consider using SpotHero or Parkwhiz to reserve parking in advance.

rideshare.note: Rideshare pickups and drop-offs are directed to North Jackson Street near the South Gate.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at BMO Pavilion varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by BMO Pavilion, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in BMO Pavilion's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call tickets can be picked up at the South Gate Box Office on the day of the show only. During Summrfest, the Box Office is open from 10:00 am - 9:00 pm on festival days.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at BMO Pavilion. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
